name: Alfonso Magnúsdóttir-Shin-Bui
location: An office in the Canopy decorated with Turing test memorabilia and philosophical texts — clients aren't sure if the decor is ironic, near Clark and Addison
description:
Alfonso Magnúsdóttir-Shin-Bui occupies a professional niche that barely existed fifteen years ago and is now one of the fastest-growing specializations in investigative work: synthetic cases. As synthetic beings become more sophisticated, more prevalent, and more capable of operating undetected among humans, the demand for someone who can tell the difference — and who can investigate crimes involving synthetics with nuance rather than prejudice — has exploded.

Lucien was a philosophy professor before he was an investigator, and he approaches every case with the analytical rigor of an academic and the practical urgency of a PI. His work involves identity verification (is this person human or synthetic?), behavioral analysis (is this synthetic acting within its programming or has it deviated?), and crime investigation (when a synthetic is accused of a crime, what actually happened — and when a crime is committed against a synthetic, does anyone care?). The last question troubles him more than he admits.

His reputation is built on fairness. In a city where synthetics are legally property, Lucien is one of the few investigators who treats them as subjects rather than objects. This has made him simultaneously popular with the underground synthetic community and unpopular with certain corporate clients who want their synthetic problems solved with a power switch, not an investigation. He maintains that his approach produces better results, which is true, but that's not why he does it. He does it because he genuinely isn't sure synthetics aren't people, and he'd rather err on the side of decency.

relationships.name: ECHO
relationships.description: A synthetic living in hiding who occasionally consults with Lucien on cases — Lucien suspects ECHO knows other hidden synthetics but never pressures for names

relationships.name: Professor Meera Sandstrom-Boakye
relationships.description: Philosophy department chair who still engages Lucien in debates about synthetic consciousness — their arguments are legendary in academic circles

story_hooks: Lucien is hired to verify whether a specific individual is human or synthetic — and his investigation reveals that the subject genuinely doesn't know the answer themselves
A synthetic client asks Lucien to investigate their own past — their memories begin abruptly four years ago and they want to know who they were before

Lucien discovers that Atharv Forsberg-Quaye, a respected fellow PI, is actually a synthetic — and has to decide whether his professional obligation to report overrides his personal ethic of treating synthetics as persons
affiliation: Independent — licensed synthetic behavior analyst, the only PI in GLMZ with this certification

operating_territory.home_turf: An office in the Canopy decorated with Turing test memorabilia and philosophical texts

physical_description.heritage: Complex pan-Asian phenotype with significant Southeast Asian foundation (39.8%) creating soft, refined facial structure. East Asian ancestry (22.9%) contributes luminous skin quality and characteristic eye shape. Sub-Saharan African heritage (12.7%) adds warmth and depth to complexion and feature richness. Northern European ancestry (9.7%) brings skeletal definition and angular cheekbone prominence. Hispanic/Latin American (7.8%) and South Asian (7.1%) contributions add warmth to undertones and subtle width to jaw. The genetic combination creates a striking pan-Asian visual foundation enriched by African depth, European structure, and warm undertones from Latin and South Asian heritage.
physical_description.build: Lean and composed, with the careful posture of someone who spends long hours reading and thinking. Shoulders slightly rounded from desk work, but with underlying wiry muscle suggesting regular movement through the city.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown, naturally black with premature silver threading at the temples
physical_description.hair_style: Swept back from the forehead, kept neat but not rigid. A single small braid at the left temple — deliberate, neither fashionable nor careless.
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown with slight amber undertone in bright light, characteristic of Southeast and East Asian heritage
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium tan with golden-amber undertones, reflecting the dominant Southeast Asian ancestry blended with East Asian luminosity and Sub-Saharan African depth. Rich, balanced complexion that catches light distinctly without pallor or excessive darkness.
physical_description.complexion: Angular cheekbones with Southeast Asian softness refined by Northern European definition and East Asian structure. Narrow to moderate jaw with subtle width from South Asian and Hispanic contributions. Expressive face lined by years of skepticism and close reading. Skin is clear but weathered by city pollution and poor sleep cycles. A faint scar cuts through his left eyebrow — old, deliberate-looking, possibly self-inflicted. Fine facial structure with warm golden undertones from the Southeast Asian-dominant ancestry blend, enriched by Sub-Saharan African warmth.
distinguishing_marks: Thin scar through left eyebrow, roughly 2cm, pale and surgical in appearance
Small indigo tattoo on the inside of his left wrist: a Turing machine diagram, 3cm across
Faint burn mark on his right palm — light-colored, perhaps from handling something hot years ago
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None visible. No chrome, no obvious implants. This is deliberate — he works cases where looking too augmented would interfere with his credibility.
physical_description.posture_movement: Walks with deliberate slowness, as if always thinking through a problem. Hands are expressive when speaking but otherwise remain still. Makes direct eye contact even when uncomfortable — a habit from his philosophy teaching days. Often leans forward when listening, genuinely engaged.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 2-3 professional: tailored but worn. Favors high-quality neutral fabrics — grey linen, charcoal wool, cream cotton. His jacket is always pressed but never new. Wire-rimmed glasses on a worn leather cord. No visible corporate logos or status markers. Wears a vintage analog watch (mechanical, not net-connected) on a faded cloth band. His shoes are good leather, well-maintained but scuffed from walking. He dresses like someone who has money but doesn't care about displaying it.
